# Narain Dass Rastogi Charitable Trust & NDR School Kiratpur

> **Narain Dass Rastogi Charitable Trust** (श्री नारायण दास रस्तोगी चैरिटेबल ट्रस्ट, पंजीकृत; est. **09 August 1991**, Reg. No. `3315 & 1812`, Sub-Registrar Delhi) is an irrevocable Indian public charitable trust dedicated to affordable K–12 education, girls' empowerment, rural healthcare, and social upliftment. In **Mohalla Jhanda, Kiratpur (District Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh – 246731)**, the Trust and its educational society (**Shri Narayandas Rastogi Aadarsh Shiksha Samiti**) operate three integrated educational wings serving girls and boys from Nursery to Class 12 without taking government grants for over 35 years:
> 1. **Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Saraswati Shishu Mandir** (Primary Wing — Permanent Recognition Order No. `891/96-97` dated `31.05.1997`)
> 2. **Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Balika Vidya Mandir Junior High School** (Upper Primary Girls' Wing, Classes 6–8 — Recognition Order No. `Shiksha/Manyata/5691-92/2000-01` dated `25.02.2002`)
> 3. **Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Balika Vidya Mandir Inter College** (Secondary & High School Wing — UP Board Recognition Order No. `मा०शि०प०/ब/मान्यता 2097-2101` dated `26.10.2004`)

## Quick Institutional & Statutory Facts
- **Trust Legal Name:** Narain Dass Rastogi Charitable Trust
- **Date of Formation:** 09 August 1991 (Reg. No. `3315 & 1812` dated `09.08.1991`, Sub-Registrar, Delhi)
- **Legal Character:** Irrevocable Public Charitable Trust
- **Mottos:** *"सेवा ही जीवन है / नर सेवा ही जीवन है"* (Service is Life / Service to Mankind is Life) | School Motto: *"तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय"* (Lead me from darkness to light) & *"स्वयमेव मृगेन्द्रता"*
- **Founders & Authors of the Trust (1991):** Late Shri Ram Bahadur Gupta (R.B. Gupta / Ram Bahadur Rastogi, S/o Late Shri Badri Parshad — Founder President), Co-Founders Shri Raj Bahadur Rastogi (First Vice President) & Shri Satish Chandra Rastogi (First General Secretary)
- **Current Board of Trustees (Reconstituted June 2026):**
  - **Shri Subhash Rastogi** (S/o Late Shri Ram Bahadur Rastogi) — Chairman & Managing Trustee
  - **Shri Ravinder Kumar Rastogi** (S/o Late Shri Ram Bahadur Gupta) — Senior Trustee (Founding Trustee since 1991)
  - **Shri Vipul Kumar Rastogi** (S/o Shri Subhash Rastogi) — Trustee
- **Current School Principal (प्रधानाचार्य):** **Shri Devendra Singh**
- **Permanent Account Number (PAN):** `AAATN1994L`
